name: [⚡] +1 Speed Rails Escape
desc:
Welcome to +1 Speed To Escape The Rails ⚡

How to Play:
👟Gain speed with every step you take!
🏆 Defeat stages to earn Trophies!
💪Train on treadmill or run through the map to increase speed!
🔥Rebirth and break limits!
🎮Climb the leaderboards and show who's the #1!

👍 Like & Favorite the game!
🌎Join the group for Rewards & Updates!
